CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `agencyConfig3` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `agencyName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `agencySlug` varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `logoUrl` text,
  `brandColor` varchar(20) DEFAULT '#F97316',
  `phone` varchar(30),
  `email` varchar(320),
  `website` text,
  `address` text,
  `city` varchar(100),
  `state` varchar(100),
  `installationChargePerKw` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 8000,
  `marginPercent` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 15,
  `botGreeting` text,
  `botTone` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'friendly',
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `panelProducts3` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `agencyId` int NOT NULL,
  `brand` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `model` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `wattage` int NOT NULL,
  `pricePerPanel` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `efficiency` decimal(5,2),
  `panelType` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'monocrystalline',
  `warranty` int DEFAULT 25,
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `inverterProducts3` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `agencyId` int NOT NULL,
  `brand` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `model` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `capacityKw` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL,
  `price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `inverterType` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'string',
  `warranty` int DEFAULT 10,
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversations3` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `agencyId` int NOT NULL,
  `sessionId` varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `customerName` varchar(200),
  `customerPhone` varchar(30),
  `customerEmail` varchar(320),
  `customerCity` varchar(100),
  `customerState` varchar(100),
  `customerAddress` text,
  `monthlyBill` decimal(10,2),
  `monthlyUnits` int,
  `recommendedKw` decimal(6,2),
  `recommendedPanels` int,
  `estimatedCost` decimal(12,2),
  `subsidyAmount` decimal(10,2),
  `netCost` decimal(12,2),
  `estimatedSavingsMonthly` decimal(10,2),
  `paybackYears` decimal(4,1),
  `status` enum('active','lead_captured','estimate_given','converted','dropped') DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  `leadScore` int DEFAULT 0,
  `messageCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `source` varchar(100) DEFAULT 'ad_click',
  `utmSource` varchar(100),
  `utmMedium` varchar(100),
  `utmCampaign` varchar(200),
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chatMsgs3` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `conversationId` int NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('bot','customer') NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `messageType` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'text',
  `metadata` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `stateSubsidies3` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `stateName` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `stateCode` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `centralSubsidy1kw` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 30000,
  `centralSubsidy2kw` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 60000,
  `centralSubsidy3kw` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 78000,
  `centralSubsidyAbove3kw` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 78000,
  `stateAdditionalPerKw` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
  `stateMaxAdditional` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
  `avgElectricityRate` decimal(6,2) DEFAULT 7.50,
  `discomName` varchar(200),
  `netMeteringAvailable` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `specialNotes` text,
  `avgSunHours` decimal(4,1) DEFAULT 4.5,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

ALTER TABLE `leads2` ADD COLUMN `conversationId` int DEFAULT NULL;
